title: Parlay maker (paper) status and what it should earn when funded. Running clean: one socket, confirm rate 6 of 6, 12-28% of RFQs priced (a fresh engine job starts near 13% and warms up for about an hour). Our fair checks out against real results: 579 graded game-line legs hit 58.2% vs 59.2% fair; 2,025 parlays hit 21.8% vs a 23.7% fair, and users paid 24.3% for them. Expected profit if the fair is true: about $4 a day per $100 of capital (2-5%/day), so roughly $3-4/day on your $85, $9/day on $200, $23/day on $500; if only half the edge is real, half that. Noise is far bigger than the edge at this size (about $30/day swing on $85), so judge it only after about 100 settled fills. The 3 live parlays that have settled all hit for the user (-$7.09; 16 open), a 17% bad-luck event, not yet evidence. New: when LIVE, quotes now ask a 3%/day return on collateral (the market wants $1,100 of new collateral an hour; capital is the limit). Still paper. Details: research/parlay_expected_profit_2026-11-19.md.
